arguments.value: 19-year-old female with a history of ocular migraines presented with progressive headache changes, dizziness, gait instability, and lower-extremity paresthesias. MRI showed a non-enhancing expansile right pontine lesion extending into the middle cerebellar peduncle and posterolateral medulla with fourth ventricle effacement, concerning for DIPG/infiltrating glioma. She was transferred for biopsy prior to radiotherapy to confirm histology and molecular features for treatment planning and clinical trial eligibility.
